body:
Should we follow similar abbreviation for TOCTOU, that is aligned with CWE-367 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/367) in [15.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x24-V15-Coding.md#v154-concurrency)?

> Concurrency issues such as race conditions, **TOC/TOU** vulnerabilities, deadlocks, livelocks, thread starvation, and improper synchronization can lead to unpredictable behavior and security risks. This section includes various techniques and strategies to help mitigate these risks.
Here we have TOC/TOU

In [15.4.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x24-V15-Coding.md#v154-concurrency) we have
> Verify that all access to shared resources is consistently checked and accessed in a single atomic operation to prevent **Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU)** race conditions, ensuring resource state consistency between check and use. 

Suggestion: 
In start of section put following: 
> Concurrency issues such as race conditions,  **Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU)** vulnerabilities, deadlocks, ....

And add this abbreviation to [Appendix A](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x90-Appendix-A_Glossary.md)

comments.body:
Related to #1875, #2201

I think correct usage for this is all-lowercase in text (section text and requirement)
@elarlang, I meant to remove "/" from "TOC/TOU", and use just "TOCTOU" everywhere.

Ack, all those problems should be solved anyway:
* one way and style for acronym (TOCTOU)
* one way and style for presenting it in text (most likely lowercase "time-of-check to time-of-use as it is not an official technical name for anything) - depends on #1875 
* add it to the Glossary - #2201
Sounds like specifically for this issue, we should unify use of TOCTOU and add it to the glossary. Should @oleksiidov open a PR with that?

@tghosth, @elarlang, thank you for comments! 
Yes I will open PR for this.
